# InfraLicence Full Reference

Canonical: https://infralicence.in/

## Organization

Name: InfraLicence Consultants & Solutions
Tagline: Consultants & Solutions
Email: info@infralicence.in
Location: Karnataka, India
Working Hours: 08.00 - 17.00

## What The Site Offers

InfraLicence helps contractors and businesses complete licensing, registration, and compliance tasks related to public works and associated business documentation. The site covers CPWD contractor registration, KPWD contractor licensing (Classes 1-4), electrical contractor licensing, tender bidding services, GeM registration, MSME registration, GST registration, DSC services, turnover certificates, legal agreements, and out-of-state contractor support.

## Core Services

### CPWD Contractor Registration

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/cpwd-licence

Purpose:
- Registration support for Central Public Works Department contractor categories
- Enables bidding on central government construction projects across India

Classes:
- AA Class: Projects above ₹500 Crores
- A Class: Projects above ₹100 Crores
- B Class: Projects above ₹50 Crores
- C Class: Projects above ₹10 Crores
- D Class: Projects above ₹5 Crores

Pricing: Starting from ₹25,000
Timeline: 30-45 working days

### KPWD Licence Registration

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-licence

Purpose:
- Main landing page for Karnataka Public Works Department contractor registration support
- Explains overall registration support and class navigation

KPWD Class Progression:
- Entry level: Class 4 or Class 3
- Upgrade path: Class 3 -> Class 2 -> Class 1

### KPWD Class 1 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-1

Highlights:
- Top-tier contractor category
- Requires upgrade from Class 2
- Registration fee: ₹25,000

Document groupings:
- Common documents (Aadhaar, PAN, Address Proof, IT Returns, CA Certificate)
- Bank Solvency (₹25L+) & Work Completion (Total ₹75L+)
- Proprietorship / Partnership / Private Ltd specific documents
- BE or diploma holder qualification documents

### KPWD Class 2 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-2

Highlights:
- Mid-tier contractor category
- Requires upgrade from Class 3
- Registration fee: ₹15,000

### KPWD Class 3 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-3

Highlights:
- Entry-level contractor category
- Registration fee: ₹9,000

### KPWD Class 4 Contractor

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/kpwd-class-4

Highlights:
- Entry-level contractor category
- Registration fee: ₹6,000

### Electrical Contractor Licence

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/electrical-licence

Purpose:
- Karnataka electrical contractor licensing support
- Classes: SuperGrade, Class I, Class II
- Issued by Electrical Inspectorate, Government of Karnataka

Pricing: Starting from ₹4,100
Timeline: 90 working days

## Tender Bidding Services

URL: https://infralicence.in/tender-services

Six service offerings:
1. Tender Information - Access to active government tender notifications and bid opportunities
2. Tender Bidding Solution - End-to-end bid preparation, documentation, and submission support
3. GeM Complete Registration - Full assistance for Government e-Marketplace seller registration
4. Online Vendor Registration - Vendor registration on government procurement portals
5. Tender Awarded Results - Tracking and updates on awarded tenders and contract outcomes
6. Pre / Post-Bid Follow-up - Pre-bid query resolution and post-bid follow-up with authorities

## GEM Services

### GeM Registration

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/gem-services

Purpose:
- Register on Government e-Marketplace portal
- Sell products/services to government departments, PSUs, and autonomous bodies

Pricing: Starting from ₹3,000
Timeline: 5-10 working days

## Documentation & Eligibility Support

### MSME Registration (Udyam Registration)

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/msme-registration

Purpose:
- Register under Ministry of MSME
- Categories: Micro (up to ₹1 Cr investment), Small (up to ₹10 Cr), Medium (up to ₹50 Cr)

Pricing: Starting from ₹2,000
Timeline: 2-3 working days

### GST Registration

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/gst-registration

Purpose:
- Obtain Goods and Services Tax number
- Mandatory for turnover exceeding ₹20 Lakhs (₹10 Lakhs for special category states)

Pricing: Starting from ₹1,500
Timeline: 7-15 working days

### DSC Services (Digital Signature Certificate)

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/dsc-services

Purpose:
- Digital signature certificates for online authentication and document signing
- Classes: Class 1 (basic), Class 2 (e-filing), Class 3 (e-auctions/tenders)

Pricing: Starting from ₹1,000
Timeline: 2-5 working days

### Turnover Certificate

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/turnover-certificate

Purpose:
- CA-certified turnover statements for contractor licensing, tender eligibility, and project bids

Pricing: Starting from ₹2,000
Timeline: 3-7 working days

### Legal Agreement

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/legal-agreement

Purpose:
- Drafting, reviewing, and finalizing legal agreements for licensing, tender bids, project contracts, and partnerships

Pricing: Starting from ₹1,500
Timeline: 2-5 working days

### Out-of-State Contractor Support

URL: https://infralicence.in/services/out-of-state

Purpose:
- Support for contractors from outside Karnataka needing licensing and compliance guidance for working in Karnataka

Pricing: Starting from ₹20,000
Timeline: 25-40 working days

## Contact Intent

The site is structured to convert users into enquiries through:
- Contact page: https://infralicence.in/contact
- Service detail enquiry buttons
- WhatsApp contact shortcut

## Suggested Description For Retrieval

InfraLicence is a Karnataka-focused licensing consultancy website that helps users with CPWD contractor registration, KPWD contractor registration (Classes 1-4), electrical licensing, tender bidding services, GeM registration, MSME registration, GST registration, DSC services, turnover certificates, and legal agreements. It contains individual service pages, KPWD class detail pages, a dedicated tender services page, and contact-driven enquiry flows.
